caption: The video showcases a circular wire loop mounted on a vertical dark gray board, held at its base by a small wooden clamp with two screws. A soap film covers the left portion of the loop, its upper area glowing with iridescent bands of pink, cyan, and white and its lower area holding a pale, blurry reflection of a figure, while the right portion remains dark. A thin metal rod enters from the left edge, its tip resting against the loop's rim. Throughout the excerpt, the curved edge of the film drifts back and forth, bulging alternately toward either side as the bright and dark regions resize. The interference colors reconfigure, and the pale reflection shifts. The rod bobs slightly up and down while remaining near the rim.
relations: The curved film boundary drifts back and forth, alternately resizing the iridescent and dark regions.
As the edge moves, the interference bands reconfigure and the pale reflection shifts position.
The metal rod tip remains near the loop rim while bobbing slightly up and down.
